about: Family A's pages (O33, PR 3), rendered from the stored shapes: paddock-data 868b8dc4 (22 Nov 2026), its results, standings and timetables as the publisher keeps them (family A's block of #1200). Every round keeps its races; the rounds the tests read whole keep their practice and qualifying too: Formula 2 rounds 4 (Monaco), 11 (Madrid), 12 (Baku) and 13 (Qatar, nothing stored), Formula 3 rounds 2 (Monaco), 8 (Monza) and 9 (Madrid), MotoGP rounds 17, 18 (its Grand Prix called off), 21 (its Grand Prix not stored yet) and 22 (nothing stored), WorldSBK rounds 9 (Race 1 restarted) and 12, DTM rounds 4 (the Norisring, qualifying in groups) and 8. Each round as calendarRounds resolves it, the teams of drivers.json with their colours and `also`, and champions.json's seasons from 2024 with champion-notes.json's 2026 note. No table is cut.

2026.clinched: Feature Race 2, Madrid, 13 September 2026, the last race of the season
2026.note: Ugochukwu started the last race of the year from second, level on points with Freddie Slater, and finished second behind Tuukka Taponen, who took his first Formula 3 win. A late safety car set up a sprint over the final lap, but Slater started and finished eighth, so the title went to the Campos Racing driver on 159 points to Slater's 145. He is the first Formula 3 champion from the United States, and Campos won the teams' title as well, with 334 points.

2026.clinched: Race 2, Cremona, 27 September 2026, with six races to spare
2026.note: Bulega needed a top-five finish in the last race of his home round and came second, behind his Aruba.it Racing team-mate Iker Lecuona, which settled it with six races still to run. He had won 23 races in the first eight rounds, 21 of them in a row, and with the four he won at the end of 2025 that made a winning streak of 25, the longest the championship has seen. Runner-up twice before, he is the second Italian to win the title and the first rider to win both the WorldSSP and WorldSBK championships, having taken WorldSSP in 2023.

2026.clinched: Race 2, Hockenheimring, 11 October 2026, the last race of the season
2026.note: Preining came to the last race of the year 20 points clear and settled it from seventh on the grid. He was fourth after the opening lap and second by the closing stages, behind Maro Engel's winning Mercedes-AMG, until Ricardo Feller, his Manthey team-mate, passed him on the final lap; third was enough. It was his second title, after 2023, and he finished on 225 points to Engel's 213. Manthey took the teams' title, and Mercedes-AMG the manufacturers'.
